plugin.notes: 2.6.3: the panel lists your paired phones (names and last seen) with a Pair another phone button, and explains why pairing waits when the relay isn't connected. Since 2.6.0 Orca installs plugin updates (Settings → Plugins → Update).

relay.notes: Relay 1.2.0: Deploy-button Workers are locked to the first desktop (no one else can use your Worker or its quota), max 4 phone connections per IP, smaller pre-connection buffer.
